import json,sqlite3,os
# Fixture: two claims at clock 1000, one confirmed and one waiting; owner is the live test process.
conn=sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(dash.HOOKS, 'session-operations.sqlite3'))
before=list(conn.iterdump())
out = [list(dash.session_configure(json.loads(s))) for s in ["{\"session\":\"audit\",\"pane\":\"%7\",\"requestId\":\"repetida-0001\",\"accountOnly\":true,\"harnessAccount\":\"work\",\"interrupt\":true}", "{\"session\":\"audit\",\"pane\":\"%7\",\"requestId\":\"repetida-0001\",\"accountOnly\":true,\"harnessAccount\":\"main\",\"interrupt\":true}", "{\"session\":\"audit\",\"pane\":\"%8\",\"requestId\":\"en-curso-0001\"}"]]
assert list(conn.iterdump()) == before, 'cached requests must not mutate the journal'
print(json.dumps(out))
